about_the_game:
• Story

    • The story of a government worker who finds and reports anomalies to the government in three bizarre places where anomalies are occurring

    • The main character who is a security guard at a hotel where the abnormal phenomenon occurs is elected as a suitable person for the area exploration project where the abnormal phenomenon occurs and works in two other places

    • Common anomalies deal with anomalies reported by the government after a certain period of time

  • How to play the game

    • It will be held for 8 hours from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m

    • Allow time to memorize objects on the map from 10 to 10:30 without any anomalies

    • At any given time, a specific monster is summoned to the map to chase the player

    • Press the report to view the detected anomalies in a format

    • If you report, you will see a UI that says it is being fixed on the screen, and depending on the result, it will be fixed and misreported. When the number of misreports reaches a certain number of times, the game is over

    • Re-reporting is not possible for a certain period of time, regardless of success or failure

    • Among the abnormalities, ghosts and monsters move around the hotel, and if you are caught by a ghost or monster, the game ends

    • If the number of anomalies accumulates too much during the process, send a warning to the UI, and when a certain number is reached, the game is over

    • If the game doesn't end and lasts until 6 o'clock, clear

content_descriptors.notes: There is a nude enemy roaming the map (Hotel)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 or i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Window 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 or i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1660 Super
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A first-person 3D game in which a night guard working in a hotel where an anomaly occurs finds the anomaly and reports it to the government and survives the enemy
